persons.name: Ratnasaṅgha
persons.evidence: ratnasaṅghena sarvvadā | ratneśvaraḥ prayatnena sthāpito’yaṃ sur-ottamaḥ || bhagavate ratneśvarāya ratnasaṅghena dattaṃ kṣetraṃ

relations.evidence: rājñaḥ śrīmānadevasya samyak-pālayataḥ prajāḥ || āṣāḍhamāse tat-pādabhaktyā vidhivad-ratnasaṅghena

purpose: installation of a Śivaliṅga (Ratneśvara) and grant of lands to it
notes: Inscription on the pedestal (jala-hari) of a liṅga in Patatole, Deopatan. Ratnasaṅgha established the Ratneśvara liṅga and donated parcels of land in several localities (Duṃlaṅ, Khopṛṅ, Duṃpraṅ, Hmaspriṅ, Vilivikṣa, Vāgvatīpāra, Vemmā, Khainaṣpu, Valala, Yūpagrāma).
